projects.title: EmojiBot
projects.description: An emoji recommendation engine: a PyTorch / NLTK model trained on emoji-rich tweet data suggests the right emoji for any message, wrapped in a full-stack chat app and analytics dashboards.
highlights: PyTorch model trained on tweet data to predict emojis from free text
Flask inference API paired with a Node.js chat interface
Dashboards exploring word frequencies and emoji similarity

projects.title: Reversi Telegram Bot
projects.description: A Telegram bot that plays Reversi (Othello) in-chat with an 8×8 inline keyboard board, complete move validation, and a heuristic AI opponent.
highlights: Compact base-3 encoding keeps board state inside callback data
Greedy move scoring: the bot picks the move that flips the most discs

projects.title: Solvable Sheep Agent
projects.description: A desktop automation agent that plays the Solvable Sheep puzzle by detecting tiles through template matching and clicking the best moves.
highlights: Template matching across 10 tile types with confidence thresholds
Idle detection and fail-safe loop control for hands-off play

projects.title: Open Source
projects.description: Working hands-on with production-grade Python ecosystems — FastAPI for APIs and Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
highlights: Exploring FastAPI internals, routing, and request handling
Experimenting with Airflow DAGs and pipeline orchestration
